title: Membrane.
officialText:
A membrane meeting the fire propagation performance criteria of NFPA 701 shall be permitted to be
used as the roof or as a skylight on buildings of Type IIB, III, IV and V construction, provided it is at least 20 feet (6096 mm)
above any floor, balcony or gallery, and meets the fire classification requirements of Section 1505 for roof assemblies.
